title: System Implementation (Post-Audit Redesign)
objective: Implement all systems from Phase 2 through Phase 4 against redesigned contracts
scope: Phase 2 (targeting, attack, combat-skills, potion-regen, movement), Phase 3 (objective, party), Phase 4 (merchant strategy, merchant-skills)
why_now: Foundation complete, audit done, contracts redesigned and corrected. Implementation is the next link in the M1 chain.

recent_updates.summary: Phase 2 and Phase 3 implemented. Targeting system supports melee/ranged/heal strategy composition. Movement rewritten with reactive kiting for non-tanks. Potion-regen uses character.targets + ctx.world hostiles. Objective system with hunter strategy. Party system with tank identification. Boot.js rewired. combat.js deleted.

Documentation corrections: targeting strategies restructured to melee/ranged/heal composition, movement kiting redefined as reactive non-tank behavior, tank identification added to party contract, priest-specific language removed in favor of capability-based checks.

phase0_implementation.description: Scheduler, event bus, shared context — Phase 0 skeleton
phase0_implementation.notes: Implemented pre-audit. Contracts unchanged — no rework needed.

phase1_implementation.notes: World-model contract revised: friendly/hostile now independent categories, friendlyPlayers config added.

audit_and_redesign.description: Audit existing implementation, redesign system decomposition, revise contracts
audit_and_redesign.notes: Combat decomposed into targeting + attack + combat-skills. Merchant absorbed into objective. Potion-regen and movement contracts revised.

phase2_targeting.description: Targeting system — melee/ranged/heal strategy composition, priority selection, stickiness, party dedup
phase2_targeting.notes: Implements createTargeting(ctx, strategies[]), createMeleeTargetingStrategy(), createRangedTargetingStrategy(), createHealTargetingStrategy(). Heal gated on character.heal > 0.

phase2_attack.notes: Thin executor reading ctx.targeting. Heal priority over attack. Adaptive delay.

phase2_combat_skills.description: Combat skills — class-specific skill use on independent cooldowns
phase2_combat_skills.notes: No-op strategy for Phase 2. Strategy interface documented for future class strategies.

phase2_potion_regen.description: Potion/Regen — uses character.targets + world hostiles, adaptive scheduling
phase2_potion_regen.notes: Revised: combat context from character.targets + ctx.world hostiles. All returns provide { delay }.

phase2_movement.description: Movement — reads ctx.objective + ctx.targeting, reactive kiting for non-tanks
phase2_movement.notes: Rewritten. Mode detection from ctx each tick. Melee approach+hold, ranged maintain range, reactive kite when non-tank targeted.

phase2_boot_wiring.description: Boot.js — all systems wired, strategy selection at boot, conditional registration
phase2_boot_wiring.notes: combat.js deleted. Strategy selection: character.heal > 0 adds heal, character.range > 30 selects ranged vs melee. Attack/combat-skills conditional on !isMerchant.

phase3_objective.description: Objective system — context publisher with hunter strategy
phase3_objective.notes: Hunter strategy: idle/farm/travel/recover. Farm location resolved from G.maps. Merchant strategy deferred to Phase 4.

phase3_party.description: Party system — assembly, status publishing, CM protocol, tank identification
phase3_party.notes: Tank score = max_hp + armor + resistance. Recalculated on party membership change. ctx.party.tank published.
